attributes.notes: Reliable high-damage cannon. Popular on Hornet and Vanguard variants.
Workhorse S2 energy cannon. Very common in bounty hunting loadouts.
Fast-firing energy repeater. Great for dogfighting. Overheats quickly at max fire rate.
High-output repeater for sustained dogfighting. Best used on ships with good cooler ratings.
High DPS S3 repeater. Serious heat output — pair with cooler overclocking.
Ballistic repeater — bypasses energy shields partially. Good against armoured targets.
Entry-level energy cannon. Good for starter ships like the Aurora.
Solid general-purpose shield. Fast regen but lower peak HP than Allmax alternatives.
Higher peak HP than Polar. Slower regeneration. Preferred for sustained engagement.
Max power output for combat. Very high IR signature — easily detected. Military builds.
Balanced output and signature. Popular for daily-use combat ships.
Best cooling rate in class. Allows sustained weapon fire without thermal shutdowns.
Good all-rounder cooler. Moderate EM signature. Works well on light fighters.
Fast quantum drive. Lower fuel efficiency but excellent spool time for busy trading routes.
Starter quantum drive. Low fuel consumption. Adequate for system travel.
Good fuel intake rate. Ideal for players doing long-distance hauling near gas giants.
High-thrust main drive. Best suited for Origin 300-series and 600i. High fuel cost.
Disables systems within radius including shields. Expensive to recharge. High-risk engagement tool.
Pyro-specific scanning device. High sensitivity for detecting ship signatures in hostile environments.
